newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas focus switches to backs, mirrors physic.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas focus switches to backs, mirrors physic.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures prices were up on Thursday morning, with all the activity centred on the back months.
The switch from front to back months mirrors activity on the OTC market on Wednesday evening, when several trades in the third, fourth and first quarters were done while prompt activity evaporated.
The switch in interest was attributed by dealers to the end of Amoco's offshore problems at a compression station on the Inde field, which had given a temporary boost to prompt prices.
But although 75 lots were traded, higher than in many morning sessions, there were only three individual deals done, one each in December, January and February.

Prices were significantly up from Wednesday's closing level, with December and February up by 0.16 pence a therm. This increase also mirrored the OTC market, where Q1 prices had edged up on Wednesday.

By the close of the morning session, February was offered at 16.995 pence a therm, a single tick away from the psychologically important 17 pence, but still with a way to go before reaching the contract high of 17.40 pence a therm.
